old_caption: The video depicts a close-up view of a person using a heat gun or similar thermal tool to treat a heavily soiled and rusted metal surface, likely part of a grill or cooking equipment. The individual is wearing a green glove on their hand, which holds the tool, indicating protection against heat. The metal surface is visibly dirty, with patches of rust and grime, suggesting it has been neglected for some time. As the thermal tool is applied, it generates steam or smoke, effectively loosening and removing residue from the surface. The heat from the tool is sufficient to affect the material, and the steam/smoke rising from the surface indicates the heat being applied. The background shows a concrete floor, hinting at an outdoor or industrial setting. The focus remains tightly on the thermal treatment process, highlighting the transformation of the surface as it becomes progressively cleaner. The video captures the methodical and thorough nature of the thermal treatment task, emphasizing the effectiveness of the heat application.
original_wisa_caption: The video depicts a close-up view of a person using a high-pressure water hose to clean a heavily soiled and rusted metal surface, likely part of a grill or cooking equipment. The individual is wearing a green glove on their hand, which holds the hose, indicating safety precautions. The metal surface is visibly dirty, with patches of rust and grime, suggesting it has been neglected for some time. As the water jet hits the surface, it creates a misty spray, effectively loosening and washing away the dirt and rust. The water pressure is strong enough to dislodge stubborn debris, and the steam rising from the surface indicates the heat retained by the metal. The background shows a concrete floor, hinting at an outdoor or industrial setting. The focus remains tightly on the cleaning process, highlighting the transformation of the surface as it becomes progressively cleaner. The video captures the methodical and thorough nature of the cleaning task, emphasizing the effectiveness of the high-pressure water technique.
caption: The video depicts a close, slightly high-angle view of a rusty, soot-stained metal tabletop holding a large dull-metal pot, with a single tubular leg visible at right over a concrete floor. From the left, a gloved hand holds a yellow-and-black power tool whose working tip is pressed against the tabletop along the front base of the pot. White smoke or steam rises from the contact zone and drifts right, partially veiling the pot. Dark burnt patches and scattered grit cover the surface. Across the clip the tool's tip traverses along the front edge of the pot's base from left-centre toward the right, while the tool body tilts from a steep down-left angle to a more horizontal position crossing the top of the frame. The smoke plume fluctuates in density, billowing more heavily through the later frames. A small bright reflection appears intermittently at the working tip. The green-gloved arm at the lower left grows into a large blurry mass occluding much of the left frame, while the tabletop under the tip shows progressively more of a lighter scraped patch.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
